name: ip-restriction
description: Restrict access to an API by whitelisting or blacklisting IP addresses.

fields.name: allow
fields.label: Allowed IPs/CIDRs (comma separated)
fields.description: List of allowed IP addresses or CIDR blocks.

fields.name: deny
fields.label: Denied IPs/CIDRs (comma separated)
fields.description: List of denied IP addresses or CIDR blocks.

fields.name: status
fields.label: Status Code
fields.description: HTTP status code to return when access is denied.

fields.name: message
fields.label: Error Message
fields.default: Your IP address is not allowed
fields.description: The message to send in the response body when access is denied.
